input: Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_b7.text, /moves/rook_a8.text, or /moves/rook_h8.text, the agents that went off plan through greed or amnesia, must be signed by that agent's own key, co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, and also write a /turn/ply.num value exactly one greater than its current value.
